data.body: HIGH: The recomposed Sound Test clips its right-hand footer. The built-in font advances 4 px per character, so this 32-character label starting at x=76 reaches x=203 on a 192-wide screen; a real headless render shows only `SPEED=A`, losing `UTO`. This is a user-visible regression in one of the three bundled carts and contradicts the stated complete cart recomposition. Move/split/shorten the footer so the complete status remains visible, and add a regression assertion or otherwise validate its right bound.

MEDIUM: This authoring guide updates the screen to 24x40 tiles but leaves the derived width and example at the old 18-cell geometry: a 24-cell map row is 48 hex characters, not 36, and the sample still says 18 cells and contains 36 characters. Agents following the guide will author a map only 144 px wide. Update the prose, comment, and both sample rows to 24 cells / 48 characters.
LOW: The authoritative spec still calls rshift a 256-entry shift table after SCREEN_H changed to 320. This now contradicts the API and implementation; update it to 320-entry.
